title: Percentage axis fits the data when no value is above 200%
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. Location: you are in one location (workplace) with technician clocked time over the last twelve months.
  3. Browser: you use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. Location: the workplace has technician time this year where every technician's monthly Technician Utilization is 100% or less (utilization can never pass 100%, so this always holds).
